I bought a 1971 Cardinal trailer 6 years ago, invested some serious money, and it lasted for 6 years before it started having serious structural issues mainlywood rot.  However, you are young and talented, you know how to do builds, so you should be fine.  😊 I know of a guy who bought the same basic trailer I did and rebuilt it from the ground up. It took him about a year. However, it's awesome now. So you may have some struggles to go through, but it will make you stronger and smarter, and you will know your camper well. I would suggest going solar; it's a game-changer. Keep your little fridge, too. It can plug into the solar and save you some trips to the store. Good luck, my friend.
